import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int sx, sy;
    static int[][] dist = new int[N][N];

    static class Cell {
        int x, y;
        Cell(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
    }

    static void computeDist(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[N][N];
        Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
        seen[startX][startY] = true;
        dist[startX][startY] = 0;
        q.add(new Cell(startX, startY));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[k], ny = cur.y + dy[k];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && !seen[nx][ny] && Character.isDigit(a[nx][ny])) {
                    seen[nx][ny] = true;
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[cur.x][cur.y] + 1;
                    q.add(new Cell(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int size;
    static int[][] cap;
    static int[] parent;
    static boolean[] visited;

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Arrays.fill(parent, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[0] = true;
        q.add(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            if (v == size - 1) return true;
            for (int u = 0; u < size; u++) {
                if (cap[v][u] > 0 && !visited[u]) {
                    visited[u] = true;
                    parent[u] = v;
                    q.add(u);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) a[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) b[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        sx = sc.nextInt();
        sy = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { sx = i; sy = j; }
        computeDist(sx, sy);

        boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[72][N][N][N][N]; // time 0..71, indices 0..N-1
        // initialize dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true for digits in a
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]))
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;

        for (int time = 0; time < t; time++) {
            for (int s1 = 0; s1 < n; s1++)
                for (int s2 = 0; s2 < n; s2++)
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                            if (!dp[time][s1][s2][x][y]) continue;
                            if (dist[x][y] <= time) continue;
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && Character.isDigit(a[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] >= time + 1)
                                    dp[time + 1][s1][s2][nx][ny] = true;
                            }
                        }
        }

        boolean[][][][] reachable = new boolean[N][N][N][N];
        for (int time = 0; time <= t; time++)
            for (int s1 = 0; s1 < n; s1++)
                for (int s2 = 0; s2 < n; s2++)
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                            if (dp[time][s1][s2][x][y])
                                reachable[s1][s2][x][y] = true;

        size = 2 * n * n + 2;
        cap = new int[size][size];
        parent = new int[size];
        visited = new boolean[size];

        // source to a cells
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[x][y]))
                    cap[0][x * n + y + 1] = a[x][y] - '0';

        // b cells to sink
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++)
                if (Character.isDigit(b[x][y]))
                    cap[n * n + x * n + y + 1][size - 1] = b[x][y] - '0';

        // a to b edges if reachable
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; y1++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[x1][y1]))
                    for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; x2++)
                        for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; y2++)
                            if (Character.isDigit(a[x2][y2]) && reachable[x1][y1][x2][y2])
                                cap[x1 * n + y1 + 1][n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1] = INF;

        while (findPath()) {
            int flow = INF;
            for (int v = size - 1; v != 0; v = parent[v])
                flow = Math.min(flow, cap[parent[v]][v]);
            for (int v = size - 1; v != 0; v = parent[v]) {
                cap[parent[v]][v] -= flow;
                cap[v][parent[v]] += flow;
            }
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            ans += cap[i][0]; // reverse edges from sink side to source indicate flow
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
